scientific_integrity: The proof includes the complete exact covariance equation, positive determinant, closed rational current, exact closure-error identity, derivative coefficient sign classification and independently reproducible Fock-space checks. No claims of external certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four sites, unit hopping and unit left injection/right extraction, maximal bias, locally Markovian dephasing with Lindblad jumps sqrt(gamma)*n_j. The threshold and strict closure-error sign are not claimed for arbitrary chains or bath rates. A general matrix-equation predecessor is acknowledged; independent priority audit is not performed.
title: A sharp dephasing threshold and a one-sided coherence correction in a four-site quantum wire
